usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing entry within a named SDN prefix list — changing its CIDR prefix, permit/deny action, or prefix-length range constraints (ge/le). The caller must hold SDN.Allocate on the specific prefix-list path; changes do not take effect cluster-wide until the SDN configuration is applied (reload). Use the digest parameter when making concurrent-safe updates to avoid overwriting another process's changes.

examples.summary: Update entry seq 10 in prefix-list 'rfc1918' to permit with a le constraint of 28

tips: ge and le set inclusive prefix-length bounds for more-specific match ranges (e.g., ge=24 le=28 matches /24 through /28 within the base prefix).
The 'delete' array can be used to unset optional fields (such as ge or le) on the entry without recreating it.
After updating, call the SDN apply endpoint to push the revised prefix-list to all nodes.
Obtain the current digest via GET on the entry or parent prefix-list before writing to enable optimistic concurrency control.
